title: Rhomboid-like 2 correlated with TME infiltration inhibits cuproptosis-related genes and drives malignant phenotype in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
authors: Che, Zhifei; Jin, Wenyi; Wu, Yaoxi; Li, Haoyong; Liang, Peiyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RHBDL2在肾透明细胞癌中通过Wnt通路抑制铜死亡并影响免疫微环境，属纯肿瘤生物学与临床关联研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The crosstalk between cuproptosis and the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is vital during clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) malignant progression. However, the underlying molecular mechanisms regulate this cross-talk remain elusive. Through tailored machine learning, we analyze clinical ccRCC data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) to explore the critical factors that regulate the interaction among cuproptosis, TIME, and tumor progression. We found that rhomboid-like 2 (RHBDL2), critical gene affecting this process, might inhibit cuproptosis-related genes (CRGs) and promotes ccRCC progression through the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. Next, knocking down RHBDL2 expression increased the cuproptosis-related genes ferredoxin 1 (FDX1) and lipoic acid synthase (LIAS) levels but reduced forkhead box P3 (FOXP3) levels and tumor growth in vivo and in vitro models. By employing HLY78, Wnt/beta-catenin pathway activator, we rescued the expression of CRGs and the malignant proliferation and metastasis capacity in ccRCC cells with RHBDL2 knockdown. Mechanistically, RHBDL2 inhibits cuproptosis and promotes malignant progression of ccRCC through the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. Abnormal RHBDL2 expression may cause the suppressive TIME formation by regulating Treg-cell infiltration, thus triggering immune escape. In summary, our results indicated that RHBDL2 is an oncogene that induces tumorigenesis and targeting RHBDL2 may be novel therapeutic direction for metastatic ccRCC.
abstract_zh: 铜死亡（cuproptosis）与肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）之间的串扰在透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）恶性进展中至关重要。然而，调控这种串扰的潜在分子机制仍不清楚。通过定制化机器学习，我们分析了来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的临床ccRCC数据，以探索调控铜死亡、TIME和肿瘤进展之间相互作用的关键因素。我们发现，菱形样蛋白2（RHBDL2）是影响这一过程的关键基因，可能通过Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制铜死亡相关基因（CRGs）并促进ccRCC进展。接下来，敲低RHBDL2表达增加了铜死亡相关基因铁氧还蛋白1（FDX1）和硫辛酸合成酶（LIAS）的水平，但降低了叉头框蛋白P3（FOXP3）的水平，并在体内和体外模型中减少了肿瘤生长。通过使用Wnt/β-catenin通路激活剂HLY78，我们恢复了RHBDL2敲低ccRCC细胞中CRGs的表达以及恶性增殖和转移能力。机制上，RHBDL2通过Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制铜死亡并促进ccRCC恶性进展。RHBDL2的异常表达可能通过调控Treg细胞浸润导致抑制性TIME形成，从而触发免疫逃逸。总之，我们的结果表明，RHBDL2是一种诱导肿瘤发生的癌基因，靶向RHBDL2可能是转移性ccRCC的新治疗方向。
